definition: the cardio I was once globally good at, and the stack that ended it

settled:
Beat Saber was high-quality cardio, aerobic and arms at once, and I once reached about the top seventh percentile in the world.

It did not stop working. It stopped being done, and not for one reason.

I dropped nearly all my tech in May over a severe depression about the state of the world, and the headset went into storage with the rest.

One pair of AirPods fighting to pair across desktop, laptop, phone and headset put a small friction at the start of every session. A dongle per device fixes it.

A plateau got a defensive quit out of me. Shoulder and elbow pain from overplaying got a pause that never cancelled itself.

The headset itself carries a real stress association, so the friction lands before the cardio begins. I will not build movement on a lever that needs pushing through dissonance to start.
